symptom: Supabase Preview Applicability failed with /usr/local/bin/node: Argument list too long on large exact-head check-run sets.
root_cause: The complete GitHub check-runs JSON response was injected into an environment variable before invoking Node, exceeding process ARG_MAX.
fix: Persist the provider response to RUNNER_TEMP and parse it from a file while preserving exact provider-name/app/conclusion proof semantics.
prevention: Do not pass unbounded API payloads through environment variables or argv.
Keep provider proof fail-closed: exact Supabase app, exact check name, success only.
